new_unresolved_policy: Reject any newly unresolved/degenerate parent relation; preserve and explicitly report old unresolved cases.
guards: Record all tested guards even if the first one already rejects; never retry with weaker settings.
parent_relations: Each illegal sibling pair maps to (parent,parent), always new; old legal edge uses vertex-pair plus parent incidence.
accepted_identity: Unique child_face_id; original parent_post_face_id/raw slot and barycentric corner lineage; no fabricated original slot.
